EXTERIOR EXPRESSION

performance to new heights. The gloss black
20-inch aluminum-alloy wheels have a unique
design and finish that ensure this trim stands
apart. The distinct front lower fascia and
exclusive grille mesh design add a touch of
aggression and refinement. Dark exterior
accents and gloss black body-side moldings
further enhance the vehicle's athletic appeal,
while an “S” badge on the liftgate and sleek
black roof rails complete the look.3 For those
seeking an even edgier QX60, the SPORT trim
is also available with a two-tone Black
Obsidian roof for an even more striking
contrast.
